name: ovos-remote-music-service
description: Control OVOS (Open Voice OS) music playback with YouTube Music integration via REST API or MCP (Model Context Protocol).
author: reklis

setup_notes.heading: OVOS Device Setup
setup_notes.content:
Ensure your OVOS device has the YouTube plugin installed:

pip install ovos-ocp-youtube-plugin

setup_notes.heading: Configuration
setup_notes.content:
Environment variables:

| Variable | Default | Description |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| `OVOS_HOST` | `127.0.0.1` | OVOS message bus host |
| `OVOS_PORT` | `8181` | OVOS message bus port |
| `FLASK_HOST` | `0.0.0.0` | REST API listen address |
| `FLASK_PORT` | `5000` | REST API listen port |
| `MCP_HOST` | `0.0.0.0` | MCP server listen address |
| `MCP_PORT` | `5001` | MCP server listen port |
